learning_outcomes.text: Know and integrate renewable energy technologies in the field of mechanical engineering.
Design thermal installations utilizing solar energy and/or biomass.
Able to work in a team, apply critical reasoning, make decisions, and communicate knowledge and conclusions in the field of industrial engineering.

syllabus_topics: Renewable Energy Installations: Renewable Energies: Production and Consumption in Europe.
Unit 1 - General overview of renewable energies for electricity generation
teaching_methods: Classroom presentation of concepts and problem-solving sessions, group discussion classes.
Personal study, report writing, practical exercises, independent student work.
assessment_rules: The final grade is calculated as (0.5 * Partial Exam 1 + 0.5 * Partial Exam 2) * 0.9 + Project * 0.1. A minimum grade of 5 is required for each partial exam. It is possible to retake one or all partial exams in a final exam.
